false_assumption.statement: Dr. Joshua Laffin was the sole mastermind and perpetrator of all crimes.
false_assumption.why_it_seems_reasonable: Laffin is portrayed as the eccentric, manipulative head of the secret society and is involved in many suspicious activities. His behavior and position make him a natural suspect for the mastermind role.
false_assumption.what_it_hides: It conceals Clive Lowbridge's true role as the Grand Prior and actual murderer of Brother John, as well as the involvement of other conspirators like Toby Marsh.

mechanism_description: Dr. Joshua Laffin conspired with Clive Lowbridge and others to seize control of the Proud Sons of Ragousa lottery funds and abduct Betty Carew to secure a secret book containing the society's secrets. They orchestrated a complex plan involving the staged publicity stunt, murder of Brother John, and the hijacking of the ocean liner Escorial to transport the lottery money. The plot was ultimately foiled by Bill Holbrook, Inspector Bullott, and Toby Marsh, who revealed Lowbridge as the true Grand Prior and murderer.

discriminating_test.design: Bill Holbrook infiltrates the wireless cabin disguised as a steward and administers a fast-acting drug to incapacitate the guards. He then sends a radio message to the warships to alert them of the hijacking and the ship's position, exposing the conspirators and foiling their plan.
discriminating_test.knowledge_revealed: This test reveals the identity and control of the conspirators aboard the Escorial and their plan to hijack the ship and escape with the lottery funds.
discriminating_test.pass_condition: Successful transmission of the radio message to the warships without detection or interruption by the hijackers.
